title: Document DAW sidecars in docs/tools.md, concepts and README
description:
## Intent
Tell people the command exists and how to use it with the DAW.

## Scope
- `docs/tools.md`: section "DAW sidecars" (`apricity export --sidecars`, flags, what gets written where, the corrections guard, library mode).
- `docs/concepts.md`: a short paragraph under Samples and analysis: the analysis travels to the DAW as a sidecar.
- README "Making music" block: one example line.
- No brand or product name of the DAW anywhere (say "the DAW").

## Verify
Docs render in the web app's Docs tab; every command line in the new text runs as written against the fixtures.

Commit: `docs(<this id>): DAW sidecars in tools and concepts` (type `docs`, no release).

---
**Toolchain:** every Bash call starts with `export PATH=$HOME/.cargo/bin:$PATH CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=2`; run builds and tests under the watchdog: `safe-run.sh -- <command>` (6 GB / 20 min cap; do not edit it). At most two Rust-building agents at once.
**Protocol:** specs first (write the scenario, watch it fail, then code); keep a running log with `kbs comment` (decisions, problems, attempts, outcomes); paste the tail of **Verify** before asking for review; never commit, push or close (the reviewer does, after re-running Verify). Never write the DAW's brand name anywhere.
